interpretationReason: Admired scope (top 7 by citations within publication year, no hold-out) is always exploratory (writing-bank doc 39 §2). Below the minimums of CORPUS_PLAN section 4. Synthetic journal: 7 full-text papers, fewer than 150; Synthetic journal: 2024–2025 has 7 (fewer than 20 per bucket); Synthetic control: 7 full-text papers, fewer than 150; Synthetic control: 2024–2025 has 7 (fewer than 20 per bucket).
warnings: syntax_unavailable: 1 of 12 profiled papers have no grammar parse, so their passive voice and tense values are null.
methodNotes: Values are per paper: body blocks only, publisher boilerplate (competing interests, CRediT, data availability, acknowledgements, funding, front matter), references and title removed; one paper model per member.
Profiled papers are build members that were retrieved, read in full text and have a paper on this device; held-out members are never profiled.

Continuous features compare corpora with Cohen's d (pooled SD); prevalence features with the difference in proportions. The 95% CI is a percentile bootstrap of that same effect over 2000 resamples of whole papers, independently within each corpus, seeded from the profile seed.
p values are two-sided Mann–Whitney U (normal approximation, tie and continuity corrected). q values are Benjamini–Hochberg over every registry feature with a p value; phrases form a separate family.
A feature is distinctive when q < 0.05 and |d| ≥ 0.2 or |difference in proportions| ≥ 0.1.

Machine-label features (stance, rhetoric, claim types) count a paper only when its latest run covers every body section except appendices; machineShare is the share of counted labels no person has confirmed.

Phrases: document frequency (papers using the phrase, counted once per paper) compared by G² (1 df) and Log Ratio; tested only when used by at least 5% of target papers and at least 5 papers (owner decision 5); only phrases the target uses more are listed, top 50 by G² with q < 0.05; evidence excerpts are at most 300 characters (decision 6).
Year buckets are 2 years wide from the earliest protocol year (or paper year when the protocol names none); sizes and buckets count full-text members, held-out ones included.
Not yet done: author-cluster bootstrap and leaving each control journal out.

Registry v2: the v1 features keep their v1 comparisons and form the core FDR family; the P2 features are tested with the same statistics, Benjamini–Hochberg within each family (structure, paragraphs, style, reasoning).
Per-section values other than presence are null for a paper without that role, so their summaries describe papers that have the section.

Style rates (hedges, boosters, first person) are word-list counts per 1000 body words of the role, not machine labels. Claim types per section and Toulmin elements are machine labels from the latest complete argument run, reported as prevalence.

Headings: top-level body section headings (numbering removed), document share among profiled target papers, top 10 per role. Section sequences: top-level body section roles in order, abstract/other/appendix left out, repeats collapsed; top 10.

Keywords: OpenAlex keywords of profiled papers; shares are over papers with any keyword; G² and Log Ratio as for phrases; listed when used by at least 5% and 5 target papers, top 50 by target share. Subfields: primary-topic subfield share among profiled members that carry one.

Passive voice and tense (P6, extractor tool): main clause of each body sentence as parsed by the spaCy service, shares per section role, tested in the style family; null for papers without a parse. Parser: synthetic-0+spacy-0.0.0 synthetic_model-0; 11 of 12 profiled papers parsed.

Evidence level (P7): shares of E0–E5 over main claims among live (not dismissed) arguments of each profiled paper's latest argument run; machine labels, pooled per side. Graded main claims 6 target / 6 control; without a level 0 / 0; papers with a level 6 of 6 / 6 of 6.

sample.rankingRule: top 7 by cited_by_count within publication year; equal per year; no hold-out
sample.controlRule: control venues ranked the same way: per year as many papers as the target's sample, split evenly across venues (protocol: synthetic)
